title: bingo
description: A digital Bingo app built to replace screaming numbers at family Christmas gatherings! Features a large-screen TV mode, light/dark themes, sound effects, auto-draw functionality, and a built-in leaderboard.

title: battleship
description: A passion project born out of disappointment with a physical kids' toy. I built this digital version of Battleship so my wife and I—and anyone else—could enjoy a seamless, high-quality gaming experience.

title: split-pro
description: An excellent open-source alternative to Splitwise. While not my original project, I actively contribute to it by providing full European Portuguese localization support.

title: ckeyboard
description: A highly customizable JavaScript on-screen keyboard. Originally built to solve a workplace need for specialized custom layouts, such as a full Emoji keyboard.

title: pycpanel
description: A Python module developed to automate DNS record updates via the cPanel API. Built before modern reverse proxies became widely accessible to manage home network addresses dynamically.

title: RPI4-Media-Player
description: A lightweight utility that transforms your Raspberry Pi 4 into a dedicated, seamless loop media player for digital signage and presentations.
